summary.intent: Resolve two Greptile P1 review threads on republish.service.ts (null-safety in getDueEntries and missing tombstone/userId scope on epoch-upgrade write) and push fixes to the open PR.
summary.outcome: Both P1 fixes applied, specs (71 passed) and e2e round-trip verified clean, committed and pushed on top of the release-bot's chore commit.

repo: IpnsRecord entity has nullable signedRecord and keyEpoch fields, non-null userId, and a tombstonedAt column — all relevant to republish batch safety.
getDueEntries filtered only on encryptedIpnsPrivateKey NOT NULL, leaving signedRecord/keyEpoch still nullable at the map site; filtering all three non-null is required for safe batch processing.
Epoch-upgrade writes must be scoped by userId, tombstonedAt IS NULL, and a keyEpoch CAS to uphold phase-67's tombstone-immutability guarantee.
The release-please bot pushes a chore(release) commit after PR creation; any subsequent push must fetch + rebase onto it before pushing to avoid non-fast-forward rejection.
A 18-19s e2e duration signals a startup-timing flake (BullMQ/tee_key_state race after API restart), not a real failure — rerunning immediately confirms.

code.finding: signedRecord! and keyEpoch! were dereferenced outside the inner try/catch; one null row would abort the whole batch. Fix: add Not(IsNull()) guards for both in getDueEntries.
Epoch-upgrade update({ ipnsName }, ...) lacked tombstonedAt IS NULL, userId scope, and keyEpoch CAS — a tombstoned row could receive a re-encrypted key. Fix: add all three to the WHERE criteria.

workflow: After a release bot pushes to a branch mid-session, always fetch + rebase (not merge) to keep the history linear before pushing.
TypeORM FindOptionsWhere friction with mixed nullable criteria (number | null) can be sidestepped by asserting non-null after ensuring the query already filters nulls out at the DB level.
E2e tests that follow an API restart can flake on the first run due to BullMQ startup races; a single re-run is sufficient to distinguish flake from regression.

friction: TypeScript error on update() criteria after adding keyEpoch CAS: TypeORM's FindOptionsWhere doesn't accept number | null cleanly, requiring a non-null assertion justified only after getDueEntries filter was confirmed.
Spec mock-expectation mismatch after scoping the epoch-upgrade criteria — test had to be updated to match the new WHERE shape.
E2e false failure on first run after API restart (18.99s timeout/flake), requiring a second run to confirm the fix was clean.
open_items: Remaining write-path error-handling hardening items in 2026-07-01-tee-republish-writepath-error-handling-hardening.md (section numbers were renumbered after epoch-upgrade item was closed out).
CodeRabbit thread [15] (epoch-upgrade) was deferred earlier but now subsumed by the greptile fix — should be explicitly resolved/dismissed in the PR review UI.
